Kernel: `softAttachmentMinus P j q = -SignType.sign (det (edge P (j-1)) q)`, `softAttachmentPlus P j q = -SignType.sign (det q (edge P j))`. Kernel: `SM.SoftDuplication.softAmplitudeMultiplier P j q = ((↑↑(softAttachmentMinus P j q)) + (↑↑(softAttachmentPlus P j q))) / 2 : ℚ` (SignType → ℤ → ℚ, rational division; SoftAmplitudeSectors.lean:96-98) — exactly (χ₋+χ₊)/2.
